mapper.select: SELECT P.POPUP_SN AS POPUP_ID, P.POPUP_NM AS NAME, P.POPUP_CN AS CONTENT, P.POPUP_PSTN_X AS POSITION_X, P.POPUP_PSTN_Y AS POSITION_Y, P.POPUP_WDTH AS WIDTH, P.POPUP_HGHT AS HEIGHT, P.POPUP_URL_ADDR AS LINK_URL, P.LNKG_SE_CD AS LINK_TARGET_CODE, ( SELECT F.ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO F WHERE F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = P.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO ORDER BY F.FILE_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS IMAGE_URL FROM POPUP_MST P WHERE P.DEL_DT IS NULL AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (P.PSTG_BGNG_YMD IS NULL OR P.PSTG_BGNG_YMD <= CURRENT_DATE) AND (P.PSTG_END_YMD IS NULL OR P.PSTG_END_YMD >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY P.REG_DT DESC, P.POPUP_SN DESC
